📖 Game script

Houston is 0–3 and desperate. Nico Collins returns (73+) on the slate's largest secondary edge (HIGH, severity 10.09) against a Dallas secondary missing Cobie Durant, and C.J. Stroud (246+) has room to throw even with Tank Dell out. David Montgomery is the shortest scorer at −159. Dallas scores 29.3 a game: Dak Prescott (267+), CeeDee Lamb (77+; PropStarz takes the under because Houston double-teams top receivers), George Pickens (67+) and Javonte Williams (−136 to score). Dallas is also coming off the Brazil trip, Kendra Middleton's reason to fade them. The roof is retractable, with storms possible outside. Houston by four, covering −3; 48 points.

🧠 Why the card leans this way

Read in full, the experts lean Houston. HOU: Action Network (Brandon Anderson and its preview), Sharp or Square (Chad Millman and Simon Hunter, who flagged sharp money on Houston early), BettingPros at −1.5, Jason Radowitz of BettingPros at −2.5, Stuckey, Kendra Middleton, Jason Logan, PJ Walsh's PRO projection at −3, and Wes Reynolds and Zachary Cohen of VSiN on the moneyline. DAL: Steve Fezzik (+3.5), Ross Tucker (teased to +8.5), Matt Moore (+2.5), Joe Gibbs, BettingPros at +1.5, Travis Pulver of BettingPros (moneyline), Dave Tuley of VSiN (+3.5, and +8.5 in teasers as his best bet) and Mike Florio (Cowboys 27–20). Evan Abrams' primer adds two Houston-side notes: the winless-team system plays on the Texans, and road underdogs coming off an international game are 1–12 straight up in their last 13 since 2018. Signals conflict: DAL has 80% of spread tickets and 83% of the money, yet the line moved against them from the Action Network open of HOU −1.5 to −3, a reverse move. Meanwhile the DAL moneyline is a big-money flag (54% of tickets, 73% of money). Every HOU −2.5 position is now at −3, the key number. The lean is Houston, but the spread price is gone: the HOU moneyline (−160) as a parlay leg or Collins receiving. The projection sits half a point under 48.5. Joe Gibbs has the over at 47.5 (a penalty-heavy crew) and Andrew Erickson the under 48.5, so pass the total. Card: the HOU moneyline leads the Slot 4 Afternoon parlay, and David Montgomery 2+ TDs is in the 8b 2+ TD 3-leg. HOU −2.5 is a SuperContest alternate. The DAL moneyline big-money flag is the counter.

⚠️ What breaks it

Collins is on a snap limit; Gilles Gallant's Xavier Hutchinson touchdown price assumes that. Prescott wins the shootout, and Dallas' 57% third-down rate keeps Stroud on the bench. A Dallas cover at +3 is a field-goal game. Joey Porter Jr., acquired by Dallas, carries no injury designation and could debut, which patches part of the secondary Collins is attacking.
